issues.t: Leaking capacitors in the engine computer
issues.sym: Rough running, stalling, odd shifting, warning lights, or other strange electrical behavior that comes and goes.
issues.why: Capacitors on the engine computer circuit board of the LS 400 can leak with age and damage the board. Owners note 1998-2000 cars use a revised circuit and fail less often.
issues.next: Have a specialist open and inspect the engine computer. Recapping or repairing the board is often an alternative to a new unit.

issues.t: Gauges stick or warning lights fail in the cluster
issues.sym: Speedometer or tach needles freeze, the fuel or temperature gauge reads wrong, or warning lights do not come on.
issues.why: Aging capacitors and circuits in the instrument cluster fail over time, especially in humid weather.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: you may not see your speed or warning lights, so ease off, keep a safe distance, and pull over where it's safe. Restarting the car once parked may bring the display back; if it doesn't, have it fixed before you drive again. Have the cluster sent out for circuit repair. Do not trust a gauge that freezes, especially the temperature gauge.

issues.t: Power steering pump or rack leak
issues.sym: Red fluid under the front, a growling noise when turning, or white smoke from the engine bay at start-up. Fluid can drip onto and ruin the alternator.
issues.why: Seals in the power steering pump, high-pressure hose and steering rack wear out with age.
issues.next: Check the fluid level often and find the leak source. Fix it early so the alternator is not damaged.

issues.t: Front suspension creaks and clunks
issues.sym: Creaking or groaning from the front when stopping, or a heavy clunk over bumps. The car may feel bouncy.
issues.why: Strut rod bushings, control arm bushings and struts wear out on higher-mileage cars.
issues.next: Have the front suspension inspected. Worn bushings and struts can also wear tires unevenly.

issues.t: Starter clicks but engine will not crank
issues.sym: You hear clicking when you turn the key, and it may take several tries before the engine turns over.
issues.why: The original starter motor wears out with age.
issues.next: Have the battery tested first. If it is good, the starter likely needs to be replaced.

issues.t: Air suspension leaks and the car sags
issues.sym: One corner or the whole car sits low after parking, the ride turns harsh, or a suspension warning comes on.
issues.why: The air struts and height sensors on air-suspension LS models wear and leak with age.
issues.next: Have the air system checked for leaks. Many owners of older cars convert to conventional struts and springs.

issues.t: Worn front control arm bushings on the LS 430
issues.sym: Clunking over bumps, a loose or wandering feel, or uneven tire wear.
issues.why: The rubber bushings in the front control arms crack and wear out with mileage.
issues.next: Have the front end checked. Aftermarket arms installed by an independent shop are an option.

issues.t: Rough shifting at low speeds
issues.sym: Harsh or clunky shifts in stop-and-go driving.
issues.why: Transmission control software can cause poor low-speed shift quality. Technicians recommend a software update.
issues.next: Check the fluid condition, then ask a dealer for any transmission software update.

issues.t: Door lock actuator fails
issues.sym: One door will not lock or unlock with the remote or switch, or you hear buzzing from the door.
issues.why: The small motor inside the door lock actuator wears out.
issues.next: Replace the actuator or just its motor. This is a common job on older Lexus models.

issues.t: Radiator leaks at the top seam
issues.sym: Coolant drips at the front, a sweet smell, or the coolant level keeps dropping.
issues.why: The plastic tank seam on the radiator can crack and leak with age.
issues.next: Keep the coolant topped up and replace the radiator before the engine overheats.

issues.t: Exhaust Y-pipe cracks or gasket leaks
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with code P0430, or you hear a rattle or exhaust leak under the car.
issues.why: The exhaust Y-pipe gasket can fail and the pipe can crack under its heat shield.
issues.next: Have the exhaust checked for leaks before replacing catalytic converters or sensors.

issues.t: Rear A/C line leak
issues.sym: The A/C blows warm, and you may hear hissing near the brake pedal.
issues.why: A refrigerant line to the rear evaporator can leak.
issues.next: Have a leak test done instead of just recharging the system.

issues.t: Mark Levinson stereo loses sound or volume jumps
issues.sym: No sound from the premium stereo, or the volume jumps to maximum.
issues.why: The Mark Levinson amplifier and volume controls can fail with age.
issues.next: Have the amplifier checked. Independent electronics shops often repair it for less than a dealer replacement.

issues.t: Front control arm bushings crack on the LS 460
issues.sym: Clunking over bumps, a loose or floaty feel, or a rough ride.
issues.why: The front control arm bushings on the LS 460 and LS 600h L crack and compress, often around 80,000 miles. The bushing usually cannot be replaced alone, so the arm is replaced.
issues.next: Have the front end inspected. Consider getting an opinion from an independent shop as well as the dealer.

issues.t: Brake actuator failure turns on warning lights
issues.sym: Brake, ABS and traction lights come on, or a Check VSC message appears. Some cars click or knock from the actuator when braking lightly.
issues.why: The brake actuator assembly can fail inside. Lexus issued a bulletin and extended the warranty on this part for some vehicles.
issues.next: If the brake pedal suddenly turns hard or a red brake warning comes on, press the pedal much harder than normal, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — call for a tow. Have the codes read and ask a dealer whether the brake actuator coverage still applies to your VIN.

issues.t: Valve springs may break (recall)
issues.sym: Unusual engine noise, rough idle, vibration or poor running. In rare cases the engine can stop while driving.
issues.why: Some valve springs were contaminated during manufacturing and can break. Covered by recall 10V-309.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the valve springs replaced for free.

issues.t: Fuel rails can corrode and leak (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell or the check engine light.
issues.why: Aluminum fuel rails can corrode from some ethanol fuels and leak. Covered by recall 09V-020.
issues.next: Do not ignore a fuel smell. Check your VIN and have the rails replaced free.

issues.t: Fuel leak at the fuel pressure sensor (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell around the car.
issues.why: Fuel can leak where the pressure sensor attaches to the fuel pipe. Covered by recall 14V-647.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the area cleaned and resealed free.

issues.t: Radiator cooling fan motor can fail
issues.sym: The temperature gauge climbs, especially in traffic or with the A/C on.
issues.why: A cooling fan motor can stop working, so the engine runs hot. Lexus issued bulletin LSB-0029-11.
issues.next: Pull over if the gauge climbs. Have the fans checked before the engine overheats.

issues.t: Squawk or knock from the engine bay when using the brake
issues.sym: A squawk or knocking sound from under the hood when you press or release the brake pedal.
issues.why: Lexus traced the noise to the brake system and issued bulletins for 2007-2016 LS 460/600h L and 2018-2020 LS 500.
issues.next: Ask the dealer about bulletins L-SB-0083-16 or L-SB-0026-20.

issues.t: Dashboard cracks or turns sticky
issues.sym: The dashboard cracks, warps, shrinks, turns shiny or feels sticky.
issues.why: Heat, humidity and sunlight break down the dash surface. Lexus ran warranty enhancement programs for some years.
issues.next: Use a sunshade and ask a dealer whether the dashboard program covers your car.

issues.t: Water pump leaks coolant
issues.sym: Pink coolant drips at the front of the engine or the coolant level drops.
issues.why: The water pump seal on the 4.6L V8 wears out, often around 100,000 miles.
issues.next: Replace the pump at the first sign of a leak to avoid overheating.

issues.t: Hybrid battery cooling fan clogged with dust
issues.sym: A hybrid warning light or reduced performance and mileage.
issues.why: Dust and lint build up in the hybrid battery cooling fan and filter, so the battery runs hot.
issues.next: Have the fan and filter cleaned at service visits.

issues.t: In-tank fuel pump can fail (recall)
issues.sym: Rough running, hesitation, the check engine light, or a stall or no-start.
issues.why: The low-pressure fuel pump in the tank can fail. Covered by recall 20V-012.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the pump replaced free.

issues.t: Low-pressure fuel pump can fail on the LS 500 (recall)
issues.sym: Rough running, hesitation, warning lights, or the engine stalls.
issues.why: The in-tank fuel pump can stop working. Covered by recalls 20V-012 and 20V-682.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the improved pump installed free.

issues.t: Run-flat tire sidewall may crack (recall)
issues.sym: A bulge in a tire sidewall, vibration, or tread separating.
issues.why: The way some run-flat tires were mounted may have cracked the sidewall reinforcement. Covered by recall 19V-134.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have affected tires replaced free.

issues.t: Brake booster pump can fail (recall)
issues.sym: Brake or VSC warning lights and a harder brake pedal.
issues.why: The brake booster pump can fail, turning off stability control and brake assist. Covered by recall 19V-544.
issues.next: If the brake pedal suddenly turns hard or a red brake warning comes on, press the pedal much harder than normal, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — call for a tow. Check your VIN and have the pump inspected and replaced free.

issues.t: Passenger air bag sensor may misread the occupant (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger air bag indicator does not match who is sitting there, or the air bag light comes on.
issues.why: Parts in the Executive Package passenger seat can interfere with the occupant sensor. Covered by recall 24V-275.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the seat inspected free.

issues.t: Rear knock or clunk when braking
issues.sym: A knock or clunk from the rear when you brake going forward or in reverse.
issues.why: Lexus issued bulletin L-SB-0013-22 for this noise on 2018-2023 models.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check the rear brakes and suspension against the bulletin.

issues.t: Delayed engagement when cold and shift bump
issues.sym: A delay when shifting from Reverse to Drive on a cold engine, or a bump when coming to a stop.
issues.why: Engine and transmission control software caused these shifts. Lexus issued bulletin L-SB-0039-18.
issues.next: Ask the dealer for the software update.

issues.t: Hybrid warning light in freezing weather
issues.sym: A hybrid system warning comes on when starting below freezing.
issues.why: Lexus identified this on certain 2018-2024 hybrids and issued bulletin LSB005523.
issues.next: Note the conditions and ask the dealer about the bulletin.

issues.t: Stability control may stay off after restart (recall)
issues.sym: The VSC OFF light stays on after restarting.
issues.why: Software may not turn stability control back on if the driver switched it off. Covered by recall 22V-239.
issues.next: Get the free software update.

issues.t: Backup camera image is delayed (recall)
issues.sym: The rear camera picture takes several seconds to show after shifting into reverse.
issues.why: Parking-assist software on cars with the 360-degree camera can delay the image. Covered by recall 24V-124.
issues.next: Get the free software update and check behind you before backing.

issues.t: Camera view can freeze with Panoramic View Monitor (recall)
issues.sym: The rear camera image freezes or goes blank in reverse.
issues.why: A parking-assist software error. Covered by recall 25V-744.
issues.next: Check your VIN and get the free software update.

issues.t: Instrument display may be blank at startup (recall)
issues.sym: The gauge cluster is blank or missing speed and warning lights after starting.
issues.why: A software error in the instrument panel. Covered by recall 25V-595.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: you may not see your speed or warning lights, so ease off, keep a safe distance, and pull over where it's safe. Restarting the car once parked may bring the display back; if it doesn't, have it fixed before you drive again. Get the free software update.
